page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review instructions. Attach them to an agent to add them to its prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Write a skill from scratch, or import one from a Markdown file or a zip archive.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

card.agents: {count, plural, =0 {0 agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.bodyHint: Saving a changed body snapshots the current text as v{next}. A metadata-only save does not create a version.
config.dangerBody: Deleting a skill removes it from every agent that links it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.empty: This skill has no body yet.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every body change is snapshotted. Restoring applies an old body as a new version — history is never rewritten.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.
versions.diffIdentical: This version is byte-identical to the current body.
versions.diffLegend: Green lines are in the current body only; red lines are in v{version} only.

confirm.deleteBody: Delete “{name}”? This cannot be undone, and every agent that links it loses it.
confirm.restoreBody: Restore v{version}? Its text becomes the new current version; the existing versions are kept.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a block of Markdown appended to the agent's prompt.
create.name: Name
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What this skill makes the reviewer look for
create.required: Name and body are both required.

import.title: Import skill from file
import.subtitle: A Markdown file, or a zip archive containing one.
import.fileHint: Accepts .md or .zip, up to 1 MiB. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
import.choose: Choose a .md or .zip file to see its parsed core.
import.name: Name
import.bodyHint: The body is stored verbatim as untrusted data and cannot be edited here.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.
